tasks.analysis: We know from drawings that have been preserved in caves for over 10,000 years that early humans performed dances as a group activity. We might think that prehistoric people concentrated only on the basic work that we required for survival: hunting, gathering food ,and making weapons and garments. However,it is clear from the record that group dancing was important to them. They made masks and costumes; they used much energy in the process of dancing; they recorded more drawings of dancing than of any other group activity. 从保存万年之久的洞穴壁画中我们可以得知，早期人类会将集体舞蹈作为群体活动。我们或许会认为，史前人类只专注于生存所需的基础劳作：狩猎、采集食物、制作武器与衣物。然而史料清晰表明，集体舞蹈对他们而言意义重大。他们制作面具与服饰，耗费大量精力跳舞，且洞穴壁画中，舞蹈题材的画作数量远超其他群体活动。
